risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (396.64), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinationals, with earnings binary event in 14 days compounding volatility risk.

debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely unfavourable (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising dollar), earnings binary event in 14 days, weak ADX trend strength, overbought oscillators, zero fundamental momentum, and price below both 50SMA and 200EMA eliminate conviction.
